items.q: How much do business cleanout services cost in Georgina?

items.q: Is there really no extra charge for waterfront businesses?
a: Never. The same flat pricing applies at a Keswick business and one near the shoreline.

items.q: Can you tell the difference between junk and actual marina or resort equipment?
a: Yes — that’s exactly what we sort for. Gear that’s still useful gets set aside on request rather than hauled with everything else.

items.q: Can you time a cleanout around a seasonal business closure?
a: Yes — tell the crew your business’s rhythm at the walkthrough and the visit gets planned around it.

items.q: Do you charge extra for a space that's completely packed?
a: The price reflects the actual volume and sorting required, not a flat surcharge.

items.q: What happens to fixtures and equipment still in good condition?

items.q: Can you clear the space the same day I call, outside of seasonal situations?
